name: lazy-collective-source-status
description: Shared source-status vocabulary for retained findings in PageDigest and DotRepo. Source status says whether a finding's declared sources still have the bytes it was bound to; it says nothing about whether the finding is true. Each implementation maps its own conditions onto these inputs: `observed` is null when a source is missing, failed, out of scope, uninspected or served in a different representation; `boundBodyRetained` is false when the bound source body is no longer stored locally.
owner: PageDigest test-vectors/source-status/vectors.json; DotRepo vendors an identical copy and the Lazy Collective parent checks the two match.
sourceRule: observed null -> unknown; observed differs from bound -> changed; boundBodyRetained false -> unknown; otherwise current
combineRule: any changed -> changed; otherwise any unknown -> unknown; otherwise current; no declared sources -> unknown
